basics.line: Getting the basics wrong is how small errors become penalties.

registration.line: Late or missed registration is the most common Corporate Tax penalty in the UAE.

taxable_persons.line: Who is taxable, and on what, decides everything that follows.

exempt_persons.line: Exemptions have conditions, and several need an application.

free_zones.line: One wrong income stream can cost a free zone company its 0% rate for five years.

small_business_relief.line: The relief is an election with conditions, not an automatic 0%.

tax_groups.line: Grouping changes who files, who pays and what can be offset.

transfer_pricing.line: Related-party pricing is where most groups are exposed, and where the paperwork is heaviest.

interest_limitation.line: Interest above the limit isn't lost, but only if it's tracked properly.

tax_losses.line: Losses are valuable, and easy to forfeit on an ownership change.

reliefs.line: The reliefs for moving assets and businesses have claw-backs worth knowing before you restructure.

exempt_income.line: Dividends and gains are only exempt when the conditions are met and evidenced.

deductions.line: Disallowed and half-allowed expenses are where computations usually go wrong.

foreign_income.line: Foreign income, branches and tax credits need planning before the year ends, not after.

penalties_admin.line: Deadlines and record-keeping rules carry fixed penalties that are entirely avoidable.

registration.line: Crossing the threshold starts a 30-day clock most businesses miss.

place_of_supply.line: Where a supply takes place decides whether UAE VAT applies at all.

date_of_supply.line: VAT reported in the wrong period is an error, even when the amount is right.

zero_rating.line: Zero rates depend on evidence; without it the supply is taxed at 5%.

exemptions.line: Exempt income quietly blocks input tax on the costs behind it.

designated_zones.line: Designated zones follow their own rules, and not every free zone is one.

reverse_charge.line: Reverse charge entries are missed more often than any other line of the return.

tax_invoices.line: An invoice missing one required detail can cost your customer their input tax, and you a penalty.

input_tax.line: Most businesses either over-claim or leave recoverable VAT on the table.

profit_margin.line: The margin scheme has strict conditions and its own invoicing rules.

tax_groups.line: Grouping removes VAT between members, and makes them all liable for each other.

real_estate.line: Property is zero-rated, exempt or standard-rated depending on details that are easy to get wrong.
